RE-PRAC-002.explanation: Under ORC 4735.21 an Ohio salesperson may collect money only in the name of and with the consent of the employing broker, who must keep earnest money in the trust account required by ORC 4735.18(A)(26). Handing it to the seller or holding it personally breaches the duty to account for others' funds.

RE-CON-037.explanation: ORC 4735.67(A) requires an Ohio licensee to disclose material defects the licensee actually knows that a buyer would not discover by a reasonably diligent inspection, and the duty of obedience covers only lawful instructions. Waiting for a buyer to ask is not enough.
